title: GenAI for Patient-Centric Healthcare
summary: Alkem AI Masterclass title and programme promise.
cue: Ask for one workflow pain point from the room.

title: The learning contract
summary: Four rules: approved data, bounded task, source verification, and human authority.
cue: Have participants repeat the four rules in one sentence.
notes: Use a prescription error example to make the contract concrete.

title: Four pillars
summary: A concise architecture for patient, clinical, pharma/research, and governance use cases.
cue: Ask participants to stand or raise a hand for their primary pillar.
notes: Show how workflows can span pillars.

title: Prescription extraction
summary: A safe separation of extraction, explanation, and human verification.
cue: Hide reference values until after extraction.
notes: Use the synthetic prescription image; never ask participants to use real patient documents.

title: Patient action plan
summary: Plain-language discharge and teach-back without changing clinical meaning.
cue: Ask what must never change during simplification.
notes: Connect clarity to teach-back and translation review.

title: Medical-image boundary
summary: A non-diagnostic observation workflow with limitations and escalation.
cue: Model the boundary by refusing to provide a diagnosis.
notes: Use only the synthetic radiograph and product limitation source.

title: Clinical reasoning
summary: Common, cannot-miss, missing data, and escalation kept separate.
notes: Judge the checklist against the case, not its fluency.

title: PV and evidence
summary: A side-by-side boundary for safety intake and evidence work.
cue: Ask which decisions cannot be delegated in each lane.
notes: Demonstrate neutral intake and citation opening.

title: Risk and controls
summary: A practical four-axis screen for data, impact, autonomy, and reach.
cue: Classify one audience use case live.
notes: Treat the result as governance input, not legal advice.

title: Workflow-first tool selection
summary: Cascading selectors guarantee complete, supported routes.
cue: Show a role/task/language combination in Prompt Studio.
notes: Explain that unsupported intersections are removed before selection.

title: Six hands-on labs
summary: The six 15-minute medical and pharma labs.
cue: Assign tools and cases before the clock starts.
notes: Use the 3-6-4-2 timing and require a decision record.

title: 30-day responsible pilot
summary: A six-part pilot canvas and the final accountability message.
cue: Ask every team for one success measure and one stop rule.
notes: End with a written implementation commitment.
